reason: Integrates locally downloaded Wallpaper Engine images and videos into the DeepSeek Harness web interface as selectable, persistent backgrounds with display controls.

summaries.zh: 将本机已下载的 Wallpaper Engine 图片和视频接入 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面，提供浏览、搜索、选择及背景显示设置。
summaries.en: Connects locally downloaded Wallpaper Engine images and videos to the DeepSeek Harness web interface for browsing, selection, and background display controls.

capabilities: Reads locally downloaded Wallpaper Engine metadata and media files
Scans configured local Steam and Wallpaper Engine directories
Serves selected wallpaper media through local HTTP routes
Persists wallpaper selection and display settings under the DSH home directory
